Hi team,

We need to finalize the virtual onsite for Samuel (SWE Infra). He has a time constraint on Tuesday afternoon and prefers a single-session block. To reduce context switching I propose a compact two-slot loop:

- Slot A (60m): System design + infra deep dive — Dylan (lead), Karthik (secondary)
- 15m buffer (optional break, interviewer swap)
- Slot B (45m): Coding exercise + follow-ups — Aisha (interviewer)

Total onsite time: ~2 hours including buffer and short overlap for hire manager questions.

Rationale: keeps panels focused, reduces candidate fatigue, and preserves an asynchronous debrief window afterwards. If we need a longer design portion we can flip to 90m + 30m coding, but candidate availability is tight.

Please confirm:
- your availability windows (PST) on Tue 3/9 between 12:00–17:00
- whether you prefer design-first or code-first ordering
